findings: Missing conferencia_resultado in GET response — The GET `/api/adesoes` endpoint does not include the `conferencia_resultado` field when returning adesoes rows. The modal detail view tries to parse this JSON to display validation errors and warnings; without it, the UI shows 'Erro ao processar resultado'. Add the field to the mapping in portal_server.py line 9540.

Batch reconciliation holds database connection and S4E session across 100+ records — The `run_batch_reconciliation()` function loops through all pending records in a single database transaction and reuses a single HTTP session for all S4E calls. On a busy month (200+ records) or with S4E latency, the connection locks and may timeout. Consider chunking the batch in groups of 10–20 records per commit, or releasing and re-acquiring the S4E session periodically.

No granular progress reporting during batch conferência — The frontend shows 'Processando...' with no intermediate feedback. If the batch takes 30+ seconds, users don't know if it's stalled or working. Consider adding a lightweight polling endpoint or SSE updates to show real-time progress (e.g., '23 / 150 processadas').

Validation does not check for duplicates or cross-batch conflicts — Two lotes with the same enterprise and data_entrada pass validation independently. If the same adhesion is imported twice, both will validate and be marked as 'validado'. Consider adding a pre-check for duplicate (lote, empresa) or enforcing a unique constraint in the schema.
